verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a Connection Timeline of historical connection events where you can view and download logs and find errors. It also has a built-in notification system that sends to email, webhook, or both, so the core of per-sync visibility and alerting is first-party. missing for 10: per-sync row counts, explicit run-status detail, explicit failure-triggered alerts, Slack notification channel, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see run status, logs, and row counts per sync, and failures alert me in Slack, email, or a webhook

citations.quote: The Connection Timeline displays historical information about relevant connection events. You can also view and download logs, find any relevant errors
Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.
If you want Airbyte to notify you about important events, use its built-in notification system.
